_defaultHostNote: Where toolchains run by default (local-first). Omit or "local" = this machine. Set to a hosts[] id to route every tool to that device declaratively — the agent never passes `host` per call; any tool's explicit host: still overrides.

fpga_lab._authNote: 用密钥则填 privateKeyPath；用密码则留空并在 pango-mcp.env 设 PANGO_MCP_SSH_fpga_lab_PASSWORD=...
fpga_lab._hostKeyNote: 必填。没有它 ssh2 接受任何主机密钥，中间人能拿到密码和比特流。在该主机上跑 `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub`(Windows: $env:ProgramData\ssh\ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub)，把 SHA256: 那段填进来。确实无法验证时用 PANGO_MCP_SSH_INSECURE=1 显式放行。
fpga_lab.hostKeyFingerprint: SHA256:<paste from ssh-keygen -lf on that host>
fpga_lab._modelsimNote: fpga_msim_sim host:<id> 用此远程 ModelSim 安装根目录(含 win64/)；license 走该设备系统环境变量(或 modelsim.license 显式注入)。

_boardsNote: Target Profiles (ARCHITECTURE §10): the physical target per board — device/package/speedgrade/pins/clock/flash/host. A task picks one via board:<name>; the tools pull a complete target from it and NEVER default/guess a device. fpga_env lists configured boards. Replace the placeholders with YOUR board(s). The clock LINE's frequency is board physical info too: put `freqMhz` on the clock pin (NOT defaulted/guessed) so create_project emits a real create_clock and timing analysis targets the true frequency.
